parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, made of polypropylene plastic, typically lightweight and durable.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip from drying out and prevents ink leakage when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or attached to the pen body by pulling or pushing, sometimes with a snap fit.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of transparent or colored polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the ink refill and provides the main gripping area for writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the structural support for the pen’s internal components.
